main.name: main

limitations: The maximum complete 25 ms sweep sum is an estimate: processes were sampled non-atomically and short peaks or children may be missed.
The sum is neither an exact simultaneous peak nor a strict lower bound; incomplete sweeps are retained in NDJSON and excluded from the reported maximum.
The Node OS maximum covers the entire observed command lifetime, including fixture bootstrap, all 1,024 cold controls, and teardown. It is not a bulk-edit-only peak.

Only the launched command family is followed. Detached descendants discovered before reparenting remain tracked by PID and OS start time; undiscovered children and unrelated system processes are excluded.
PID identity check and signal delivery are separate syscalls; cleanup is bounded and best effort, not an atomic handle-based kill guarantee.
Darwin physical footprint includes process charges and may double-count shared memory across processes; JS heap and Wasm capacity are separate diagnostics.
The observer scans the process table and can perturb runtime; these observations are not latency evidence.
V8 process.memoryUsage and exported Wasm capacity are separate observations; neither is added to OS physical footprint.
Explicit GC is requested after each lifecycle phase and is not proof that all memory is reclaimable.
The OS maximum spans the entire command, including all cold controls and teardown; it is not an edit-only peak.

interpretation.afterUpdate: The maximum among exactly eight AFTER-UPDATE-AND-PUBLISH checkpoints per arm. Initial publication, cold-oracle completion, and teardown checkpoints are excluded.
interpretation.native: The OS physical-footprint maximum is the largest sum from a complete 25 ms non-atomic sweep across the observed root command family. It spans bootstrap + 8 cycles + 1,024 cold oracles + teardown. It is neither an exact simultaneous peak nor a strict lower bound; short peaks or children can be missed. It is not an edit-only peak.
interpretation.separation: JavaScript heap/external/array-buffer values, WebAssembly capacity, and OS physical footprint are separate diagnostics. They are not summed and no performance or causal claim is made.
interpretation.browser: Browser report not read or polled. Rerun with --browser-report <completed-report.json> to add its exact bytes, SHA-256, and parsed JSON; no browser discovery or job interaction is performed.
interpretation.relatedSizeInventory: Separate Node gzip inventory is recorded in size-node-inventory.json; its Node gzip fields are nested under .distSizes and are outside this memory summary.
